description: This file defines an Android-specific Kotlin class 'SmsManager' responsible for sending, searching, and managing SMS and MMS messages within an app. It implements permissions handling, contact querying, message retrieval, and message sending functionalities, utilizing Android content providers and telephony APIs.

classes.name: SmsManager
classes.description: Main class managing SMS/MMS messaging, permissions, and queries on Android devices.

classes.name: SendResult
classes.description: Result object for SMS send attempts, including success status, recipient, and potential error messages.

classes.name: SmsMessage
classes.description: Data class representing an SMS or MMS message, with identifiers, contact info, timestamps, content, and status.

classes.name: SearchResult
classes.description: Contains the outcome of an SMS query, including retrieved messages and metadata.

classes.name: QueryResult
classes.description: Represents either a successful or error state when parsing query parameters.

classes.name: QueryParams
classes.description: Holds parameters for filtering SMS/MMS query results, such as time range, contact info, and message type.

classes.name: SendPlan
classes.description: Encapsulates details of message parts when sending multipart SMS.

methods.name: hasSmsPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has SEND_SMS permission.

methods.name: hasReadSmsPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has READ_SMS permission.

methods.name: hasReadContactsPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has READ_CONTACTS permission.

methods.name: canSendSms
methods.description: Determines if the app can send SMS based on permissions and device features.

methods.name: canSearchSms
methods.description: Determines if the app can search SMS messages.

methods.name: canReadSms
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to read SMS messages.

methods.name: hasTelephonyFeature
methods.description: Checks if device has telephony feature.

methods.name: attachPermissionRequester
methods.description: Sets a PermissionRequester for runtime permission requests.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Suspending function to send an SMS message with provided parameters, handles permissions and errors.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Suspending function to perform SMS/MMS queries based on JSON parameters, handling permissions and contact lookups.
